# Use the token method that matches HTTP or SASL consumers

OAuth2Module.connect requests a SASL XOAUTH2 result, while getAccessToken requests the raw access token. The shared fetch method saves changed refresh token or scope, then wraps the result only when shouldMakeSaslToken is true. CardDAV formats the raw token as Bearer. Preserve this consumer boundary when porting a DAV caller; an already encoded SASL response is not an HTTP Bearer token. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: OAuth raw and SASL token interfaces.
